Participants of the Futures tournament - together with their parents - had the wonderful opportunity to attend a lecture by legendary GM Pia Cramling!

After taking down Nodirbek Yakubboev in the 4th round of Prague Chess Masters, Jorden is now the sole leader with 3/4 points!
